toadstool: Toadstool Geologic Park in the grassland of far northwest Nebraska: pale gray badlands of eroded clay, mushroom-shaped rock pillars with flat sandstone caps, a dry wash in the foreground, a few yucca, a huge empty sky.
oneill: The main crossroads of O’Neill, a small prairie town in Nebraska: a large faded green shamrock painted across the asphalt in the middle of the intersection, two-story brick storefronts on the corners, a water tower beyond, the street empty. Full frame, edge to edge, no borders.
ashfall: Inside a long open-sided wooden shelter over a fossil dig in the hills of northeast Nebraska: the pale gray volcanic ash floor is exposed, with many complete fossil rhinoceros skeletons lying side by side where they died around an old waterhole, a few soft brushes and buckets left at the edge, grassland hills seen through the open sides.
lexington: Lexington, Nebraska, in the flat Platte valley at first light: a long freight train on the main line, concrete grain elevators, the low white buildings and stacks of a meatpacking plant, a frontage road running beside the interstate, flat fields to the horizon.
nebraskacity: An old apple orchard at Nebraska City, Nebraska, in late April: long rows of gnarled grafted apple trees in white blossom, a white-columned mansion far behind the trees, the wooded Missouri River bluffs beyond.
capitol: The Nebraska State Capitol in Lincoln seen from the long north lawn: the tall pale limestone tower with its gold tiled dome and a small bronze sower statue on the very top, rows of trees and the empty lawn in front.

beast-rhino: !A short-legged, barrel-bodied prehistoric rhinoceros with one small horn on its nose, dusted all over with pale gray volcanic ash, standing still, full body, side view, photographed against a perfectly flat, uniform pure green #00FF00 background, soft light, sharp detail. Nothing else in the frame.
